basic_info.description: Spacious second floor SOMA TIC unit features 2 beds and 2 baths with abundant natural light. This unit features an open floor plan kitchen and living room with enough space for dining. Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and gas range. Large, quiet master BR w/ walk-in closet with Bay Windows is located towards the rear for privacy. The unit also includes a separate laundry room with a washer/dryer near the hallway. Gorgeous modern finishes and upgraded features throughout, including stone countertops in the kitchen; all stainless steel appliances; double oven gas stove; beautiful hardwood flooring throughout with decorative tile in both baths; video security intercom; central heat. Basement has a very large owners' storage area. Low HOA fees. Walk to Sightglass Coffee & Folsom restaurants. Quick walk to BART/MUNI and easy freeway access.
